title: A draft or posted ticket comment (contract ticket-update v1, Phase 3)
description: Drafted by AI, every claim checked by code, posted by a person under their own login (D74). Stored in .stangent/tickets/<KEY>/drafts/<kind>-<tone>.json with its Markdown beside it.

text.description: What gets posted: the draft's text with its claim markers removed.

claims.description: Each claim and what it links to, as checked.

pr.description: resolution: the PR's range and link.

inputs.description: The hash of the writer's input: unchanged means no new AI call (D18).

posted.description: Null until a person posts it with `stangent ticket post`.
